paragraphs: He gives five teachings in Rav’s name in [Berakhot 12a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.12a.23-24) and [12b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.12b.2).[^1]

notes.text: The displayed passage on 12a has two reports. The first linked passage on 12b, [the discussion of praying for another person](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.12b.6), and [the discussion of shame after sin](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.12b.9) give the other three. One of the 12a occurrences puts “the Elder” in brackets.
